title: Design: Sorting the asset Work Orders tab keeps the Bill To column in place
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the asset's owner.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a payer.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 1, owned by customer A, with three work orders at the test location: work order 1 billed to customer B, then work order 2 and work order 3 billing customer A, so a sort changes the order.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p7-10-after-work-orders-tab-top.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open asset 1's Work Orders tab from customer A's page.
  2. Take a screenshot of the page.
  3. Click the work order number column header.
  4. Click the same header again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A "Bill To" column shows after Customer: work order 1 reads customer B's name, work order 2 and work order 3 are blank.

Step 2:

  • You have a picture of where each heading, field and button sits before the change.

Step 3:

  • The rows are in work order number order.
  • The "Bill To" column still shows, with customer B's name on work order 1.
  • Every column heading is in the same place as in your screenshot: none has moved left or right.

Step 4:

  • The rows are in the reverse order.
  • The "Bill To" column still shows, with customer B's name on work order 1.
  • Every column heading is in the same place as in your screenshot: none has moved left or right.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12316 (Story 14, Asset Work Orders tab: whole history and Customer filter)

  • S14-R6: “A "Bill To" column shows when at least one row bills someone else; it is blank on self-billed rows.”
  • S14-R1: “The tab lists every service work order on the asset at the current location, for every customer, in today's sort.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Work Orders tab, top" (page 7 "Asset Work Orders tab", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p7-10-after-work-orders-tab-top.png

The design's own words:

  • “A "Bill To" column sits right after Customer because a loaded row bills someone else. S2-17579 reads "Buda Truck Repair", "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair".”

The design draws no sorted picture; a sort changes no row, so the column rule is unchanged. The place check follows the design-case checklist (layout stays put when the screen changes state).
